description: This file defines a unit test builder class for creating 'Order' objects with default or specified values for testing purposes within the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A test utility class to construct instances of 'Order' with preset or custom data for unit tests.

methods.name: WithDefaultValues
methods.description: Creates an 'Order' with default test data.

methods.name: WithNoItems
methods.description: Creates an 'Order' with no order items.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Creates an 'Order' with a specified list of order items.
